title: Bluffs on 30A - North | KEY.co
description_expanded: Blending coastal sophistication with effortless comfort, this newly built estate delivers an unparalleled luxury experience in the heart of Dune Allen Beach. Spanning over 7,000 square feet across three thoughtfully designed levels, the home features seven elegant bedrooms plus a charming bunk area, making it ideal for large families or groups. From the moment you enter the grand foyer, the space unfolds with style, featuring a spacious game room, multiple living areas, and sweeping views that bring the outdoors in. Premium touches like an elevator, rich hardwood flooring, custom millwork, and designer lighting define every corner with refined detail. The outdoor living is equally exceptional, anchored by a private heated pool and hot tub, an expansive outdoor kitchen, and a panoramic observation deck perfect for sunset viewing. Guests can cruise to nearby beaches, restaurants, and shops on the included six-seater golf cart or explore the scenic coastline by bike with six adult bicycles provided. Whether preparing meals in the gourmet chef’s kitchen, enjoying a cocktail on a private balcony, or relaxing in one of the spa-inspired primary suites, every moment at this coastal retreat is designed to inspire.

Features: Guests assume all risk for use of pools
